newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain has no current plans for tax hikes in 98 - govt.
newsitem.headline: Spain has no current plans for tax hikes in 98 - govt.

text.p: Spain's Secretary for the Exchequer Juan Costa said on Thursday that, at present, the government has no plans to hike any taxes in the coming 1998 budget.

"On the table at the moment I do not have any plans for hiking any kind of tax, neither (value-added tax) nor special taxes (such as those levied on alcohol and tobacco)," he told to a group of reporters at a seminar.
But he added that planning for the next budget was at a such an early stage that "no decision has been taken yet".

Despite official denials of press reports on a possible V.A.T increase, more recent articles say the government is considering some tax increases (such as for special taxes) to offset possible income tax cuts.
